securityChecks.description: Requires JWT token; extracts userId strictly from req.user.userId
Query enforces WHERE user_id = $1; users can never view other users transactions
Supports limit (max 200) and offset with sanitized integer parsing
All endpoints validate amount > 0 and reject negative or non-numeric inputs
Stored as NUMERIC(14,2); rounded using toFixed(2); zero floating point precision leaks
